desc:
Welcome to Snake Wars! 🐍

🍎 Collect food to grow your snake bigger and bigger!
💥 Outsmart other snakes and eliminate them!
💰 Earn cash to unlock cool skins and upgrades!
🏆 Become the biggest snake to win!

👥 Play with friends, compete in free for all or team battles, and dominate the arena!

🎧 ASMR vibes included
✨ Smooth movement, satisfying growth, colorful visuals, and relaxing sounds for a perfect mix of competition & chill!
